_doc: Per-model rig maps for tools/build-bohrok.mjs. 'joints' maps the source auto-rig bone names to the shared Bohrok joint names (see design/bohrok-import.md). 'pivots' places a joint exactly (source model units) when snapping to a ball joint is not right. 'pieces' forces a mesh piece (found by its centre, source units) onto a part when the auto-rig weights put it on the wrong one. 'joints': 'auto' finds the joints from the skeleton's shape (tools/bohrok/automap.mjs). 'layout' reuses a verified model's rigid-part layout and pivots for pieces at the same place (all six Meshy Bohrok share one body).
